scripts.generate:foundation-go-models: cd backend && go run github.com/oapi-codegen/oapi-codegen/v2/cmd/oapi-codegen@v2.8.0 -config internal/contracts/oapi.yaml internal/contracts/openapi.json
scripts.build:electron: env VITE_ELECTRON=true npm run build -w @zenith/web && npm run build -w @zenith/electron
scripts.build:electron:win: env VITE_ELECTRON=true npm run build -w @zenith/web && npm run build:win -w @zenith/electron
scripts.build:electron:mac: env VITE_ELECTRON=true npm run build -w @zenith/web && npm run build:mac -w @zenith/electron
scripts.build:electron:linux: env VITE_ELECTRON=true npm run build -w @zenith/web && npm run build:linux -w @zenith/electron
scripts.build: npm run check:boundaries && npm run check:foundation-contracts && npm run check:foundation-ui && npm run build:elements && npm run build:go:web && npm run build:admin && node scripts/build-go-release.mjs
scripts.build:demo: npm run build -w @zenith/shared && npm run build:demo -w @zenith/web
scripts.test: npm run test:go:integration && npm run test:client && npm run test:elements && npm run test:admin && npm run test:shared && npm run test:web:foundation
scripts.lint: npm run check:boundaries && npm run lint -w @zenith/client && npm run lint -w @zenith/elements && npm run lint -w @zenith/admin && npm run lint -w @zenith/shared && npm run lint -w @zenith/web
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix -w @zenith/shared && npm run lint:fix -w @zenith/server && npm run lint:fix -w @zenith/analytics-sdk && npm run lint:fix -w @zenith/web
scripts.legacy:build: npm run build -w @zenith/shared && npm run build -w @zenith/analytics-sdk && npm run build -w @zenith/server && npm run build -w @zenith/web
scripts.legacy:test: npm run test -w @zenith/shared && npm run test -w @zenith/server && npm run test -w @zenith/web
scripts.legacy:lint: npm run lint -w @zenith/shared && npm run lint -w @zenith/server && npm run lint -w @zenith/analytics-sdk && npm run lint -w @zenith/web
scripts.check:types: npm run build:packages:core && npm run build:elements && node --max-old-space-size=8192 node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc6 -b packages/shared packages/client packages/elements packages/web packages/admin
scripts.check:boundaries: node scripts/check-client-boundaries.mjs && node scripts/check-admin-boundaries.mjs && node scripts/check-elements-boundaries.mjs
scripts.build:admin: npm run build:elements && npm run build -w @zenith/admin
scripts.predev: npm run build:packages:core && npm run build:elements
scripts.predev:web: npm run build:packages:core && npm run build:elements
scripts.build:packages:core: npm run build -w @zenith/shared && npm run build -w @zenith/client
scripts.pack:packages: npm run build:packages:core && npm run build:admin && node scripts/pack-packages.mjs
